notes: Japanese and Korean cards are now recognised from their number and picture, with the English name shown (Korean cards are matched to the Japanese printing)
Prices for Japanese cards, raw and PSA, from PokemonPriceTracker's Japanese listings. Korean cards have no price source yet, so their eBay sold searches say Korean
Price finder: "Not in the list?" looks up a card the card list doesn't have (like the Dedenne GX 195a alternate-art promo) by the name and number you typed
Updates are checked every hour while the app is open, and Settings and About have a link to review Cardwright on Trustpilot
